verses.pali: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato tayo male appahāya yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Anyone who has three qualities, and has not given up three stains, is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Dussīlo ca hoti, dussīlyamalañcassa appahīnaṁ hoti;
verses.english: They’re unethical, and haven’t given up the stain of immorality.

verses.pali: issukī ca hoti, issāmalañcassa appahīnaṁ hoti;
verses.english: They’re jealous, and haven’t given up the stain of jealousy.

verses.pali: maccharī ca hoti, maccheramalañcassa appahīnaṁ hoti.
verses.english: They’re stingy, and haven’t given up the stain of stinginess.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato ime tayo male appahāya yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: Anyone who possesses these three qualities, and has not given up these three stains, is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato tayo male pahāya yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: Anyone who has three qualities, and has given up three stains, is placed in heaven as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Sīlavā ca hoti, dussīlyamalañcassa pahīnaṁ hoti;
verses.english: They’re ethical, and have given up the stain of immorality.

verses.pali: anissukī ca hoti, issāmalañcassa pahīnaṁ hoti;
verses.english: They’re not jealous, and have given up the stain of jealousy.

verses.pali: amaccharī ca hoti, maccheramalañcassa pahīnaṁ hoti.
verses.english: They’re not stingy, and have given up the stain of stinginess.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato ime tayo male pahāya yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: Anyone who possesses these three qualities, and has given up these three stains, is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
